title: Magma Crucible
body:
# How to Use

Put stones into Magma Crucible.  It's so easy!!

This Machine needs Energy!

# How much the amount can we get lava from one stone?
Obsidian : 1000mB

Magma block : 200mB

The others stone : 50mB
